item.title: Demigods
item.description:
Is there even a Sanskrit term properly translated as “demigod”? In the Western case, I’ve found that while modern academics speak very freely of “demigods”, the actual corresponding terms in the original languages—e.g., Greek hēmitheos—are in fact quite rare.

As a name of the pUru monarch, upadeva, indeed seems to have been used similar to the aforediscussed ardhadeva – near a god/almost a god. - MT
